id: \bAnother pesty obstacle. I'm going to get this Latios one way or the other. I'd prefer to do it without casualties.
en: \bAnother pesty obstacle. I'm going to get this Latios one way or the other. I'd prefer to do it without casualties.
it: \bUn altro fastidioso ostacolo. Avrò questo Latios in un modo o nell'altro. Preferirei farlo senza vittime.

id: \bNo! How did a mere child stop me?
en: \bNo! How did a mere child stop me?
it: \bNo! Come ha fatto un semplice ragazzino a fermarmi?

id: Latios is doing better thanks to your help. It and Latias are going to return to the wild.
en: Latios is doing better thanks to your help. It and Latias are going to return to the wild.
it: Latios sta meglio grazie al tuo aiuto. Lui e Latias torneranno allo stato selvatico.
